payout_quote: To earn $250 bonus, you must 1. Qualify for and open a Membership with Chartway. 2. Open a new Cash Back Checking account, 3. Perform a minimum of 10 debit card purchases monthly using your Cash Back Checking debit card, 4. enroll in electronic statements with a valid email address, and 5. Make $500 or more in new money deposits within a monthly cycle into your Cash Back Checking account.
steps: Qualify for and open a Chartway Credit Union membership (Utah residents; no current Chartway membership; 18+).
Open a new Cash Back Checking account in the Herriman branch or through the promotional landing page at https://joinchartway.com/branch/herriman/checking/.

Each month: make 10+ debit card purchases with the Cash Back Checking debit card, stay enrolled in eStatements, and deposit $500+ in new money; the $250 bonus is deposited the calendar month after meeting the qualifications.
catches: Offer limited to Utah residents who open the account in the Herriman branch or through the promotional landing page only.
Valid only for individuals without a current Chartway Credit Union membership; must be 18+; one $250 bonus per member.
To earn: open Chartway membership, open a new Cash Back Checking account, make 10+ debit card purchases monthly, enroll in eStatements, and deposit $500+ in new money within a monthly cycle.
$250 bonus forfeited if the account has a negative balance; paid the calendar month following meeting the qualifications.
Bonus may be reported to the IRS on Form 1099; offer may be discontinued at any time; cannot be combined with other offers.
biggest_catch: Utah residents only, and you must open in the Herriman branch or via the promo landing page — plus 10 debit purchases and $500 in new deposits in the same monthly cycle.
eligibility: Utah residents only (open in Herriman branch or through the promotional landing page); individuals without a current Chartway membership; 18+; one $250 bonus per member.
timing: $250 bonus deposited the calendar month following meeting the qualifications.
